definitions.WRONG_LOGIC: Attempted product behavior fails a composed check; a behavioral classification, not proof of the unique root cause.
definitions.MISSED_REQUIREMENT: A required behavior is explicitly left unimplemented, with an independent observed failure.
definitions.UNVERIFIED_ASSUMPTION: The submission explicitly adds a restriction contradicted by supplied records and an observed check.
definitions.TASK_SIDE_UNRESOLVED: The original outcome is contaminated by a grader defect; no model attribution before a controlled replay.
